issues.description: The Layout external specifications use a generic self_ receiver and explicit dereferencing instead of a role-specific receiver name and method-call auto-dereferencing.
issues.rationale: Read LayoutAdditionalSpecFns value receiver and two assume_specification functions: self_ plus explicit dereference repeats avoidable receiver mechanics. Current named rule explicitly prescribes role name l and method-call auto-deref; correct stable rule is name-assume-spec-receivers.
